observation.visible_scene: A hamster enclosure filled with wood-shaving bedding: a blue plastic tunnel on the left, a purple water bottle (with white bear motif) mounted on the dark back wall, two metal bowls behind a green wire exercise wheel, and a glass side wall on the right that mirrors the tunnel and a bowl. Two tan-and-white hamsters are inside the green wheel.
visible_changes: The wheel is already turning at the first frame and is still turning at the last; its speed varies across the excerpt.
From about t=0.27 s to t=1.07 s the rotation is fast, producing strong motion blur of both hamsters and of the wheel's spokes/hub.
Around t=1.13–1.27 s the wheel slows markedly; the two hamsters are seen close together near the bottom of the wheel with little blur.

From about t=1.33 s onward the wheel turns more slowly, with one hamster on the left inner side and the other on the right inner side, their angular positions shifting gradually; blur on the right hamster increases again near t=2.67 s.
Background items (tunnel, bottle, bowls, glass reflections) hold fixed screen positions throughout, so the visible motion is the wheel/hamsters, not camera movement.
The right vertical strip is a glass wall reflecting the blue tunnel and a metal bowl, not additional separate objects.
outside_clip_unknowns: What occurs before t=0 s and after t=2.67 s; the cause of the wheel's speed changes (hamsters actively running vs coasting) is not shown.
uncertain_details: The exact rotation direction of the wheel; whether the upper-right hamster in the earliest frames is partly a glass reflection; the precise instant the wheel comes to rest.
